evidence: We are a non-profit cat lounge and rescue center in San Diego dedicated to saving cats from high-kill shelters and giving them safe, loving homes.
We welcome families and well-behaved dogs on leashes in our front beer garden.
We are Felton Veterinary Hospital, where pets are treated like family.
Our team provides compassionate, high-quality medical care for your pets, focusing on their health and your peace of mind.
Since the 1950s, we’ve provided animal control services, worked to reunite lost pets with their owners, and helped find loving homes for stray animals.
